hero_sub: Independent games, made to be played together.
partner_note: Games from our friends at Fazay Games.
milim_text: Guess the secret 5-letter word in 6 tries, guided by colors. Play on your own and compete for points with your friends. In Portuguese, English and Spanish.
sarrafo_text: A battle arena for up to 20 fighters. Grab runes, use special moves and grow bigger and stronger to be the last one standing.
sordim_text: A survival RPG in a big world of floating islands. Team up with friends, level up your skills and face the creatures of every region.
crav_text: A survival action game for your phone. Dodge with your finger, hold your ground wave after wave and take on the boss at the end of each map.
overspray_text: A tactical 4v4 first-person paintball shooter. Try the free demo on Steam.
poo_text: A chaotic farm tycoon: take care of the animals, collect the poo and build conveyors and machines. Coming soon to Steam.
about_p1: Lippe Studios is an independent game studio. We make games for phones and for PC, and we like games that are better with friends.
about_p2: Our games share names from Hebrew: Milim means “words”, Crav means “battle” and Sordim means “the survivors”. They all live in the same world of floating islands.
contact_text: Questions, press or partnerships? Write to us.
